fields.summary_ko.0: SanDisk (SNDK) could reach $1,600 per share in 2027 (pre-8:1 split) with 87% upside, while Wall Street consensus target is $2,047.38 (139% upside).
fields.summary_ko.1: Q1 2027 revenue surged to $11.03 billion, up 377.9% year-over-year, with GAAP gross margin at 85%, and memory chip sales secured through contracts representing 50-67% of semiconductor volume in 2027-2028.
